versos.hebraico: וַיִּקְרָ֥א יַעֲקֹ֖ב אֶל־בָּנָ֑יו וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הֵאָֽסְפוּ֙ וְאַגִּ֣ידָה לָכֶ֔ם אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר־יִקְרָ֥א אֶתְכֶ֖ם בְּאַחֲרִ֥ית הַיָּמִֽים׃

controles.web: Jacob called to his sons, and said: “Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which will happen to you in the days to come.
controles.kjv: And Jacob called unto his sons, and said, Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which shall befall you in the last days.
controles.livre: E chamou Jacó a seus filhos, e disse: Juntai-vos, e vos declararei o que vos há de acontecer nos últimos dias.

versos.hebraico: הִקָּבְצ֥וּ וְשִׁמְע֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יַעֲקֹ֑ב וְשִׁמְע֖וּ אֶל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל אֲבִיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: Assemble yourselves, and hear, you sons of Jacob. Listen to Israel, your father.
controles.kjv: Gather yourselves together, and hear, ye sons of Jacob; and hearken unto Israel your father.
controles.livre: Juntai-vos e ouvi, filhos de Jacó; E escutai a vosso pai Israel.

versos.hebraico: רְאוּבֵן֙ בְּכֹ֣רִי אַ֔תָּה כֹּחִ֖י וְרֵאשִׁ֣ית אוֹנִ֑י יֶ֥תֶר שְׂאֵ֖ת וְיֶ֥תֶר עָֽז׃

controles.web: “Reuben, you are my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength; excelling in dignity, and excelling in power.
controles.kjv: Reuben, thou art my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength, the excellency of dignity, and the excellency of power:
controles.livre: Rúben, tu és meu primogênito, minha força, e o princípio do meu vigor; Principal em dignidade, principal em poder.

versos.hebraico: פַּ֤חַז כַּמַּ֨יִם֙ אַל־תּוֹתַ֔ר כִּ֥י עָלִ֖יתָ מִשְׁכְּבֵ֣י אָבִ֑יךָ אָ֥ז חִלַּ֖לְתָּ יְצוּעִ֥י עָלָֽה׃פ

controles.web: Boiling over like water, you shall not excel; because you went up to your father’s bed, then defiled it. He went up to my couch.
controles.kjv: Unstable as water, thou shalt not excel; because thou wentest up to thy father’s bed; then defiledst thou it: he went up to my couch.
controles.livre: Corrente como as águas, não sejas o principal; Porquanto subiste ao leito de teu pai: Então te contaminaste, subindo a meu estrado.

versos.hebraico: שִׁמְע֥וֹן וְלֵוִ֖י אַחִ֑ים כְּלֵ֥י חָמָ֖ס מְכֵרֹתֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: “Simeon and Levi are brothers. Their swords are weapons of violence.
controles.kjv: Simeon and Levi are brethren; instruments of cruelty are in their habitations.
controles.livre: Simeão e Levi, irmãos: Armas de violência são suas armas.

versos.hebraico: בְּסֹדָם֙ אַל־תָּבֹ֣א נַפְשִׁ֔י בִּקְהָלָ֖ם אַל־תֵּחַ֣ד כְּבֹדִ֑י כִּ֤י בְאַפָּם֙ הָ֣רְגוּ אִ֔ישׁ וּבִרְצֹנָ֖ם עִקְּרוּ־שֽׁוֹר׃

controles.web: My soul, don’t come into their council. My glory, don’t be united to their assembly; for in their anger they killed men. In their self-will they hamstrung cattle.
controles.kjv: O my soul, come not thou into their secret; unto their assembly, mine honour, be not thou united: for in their anger they slew a man, and in their selfwill they digged down a wall.
controles.livre: Em seu secreto não entre minha alma, nem minha honra se junte em sua companhia; Que em seu furor mataram homem, E em sua vontade aleijaram bois.

versos.hebraico: אָר֤וּר אַפָּם֙ כִּ֣י עָ֔ז וְעֶבְרָתָ֖ם כִּ֣י קָשָׁ֑תָה אֲחַלְּקֵ֣ם בְּיַעֲקֹ֔ב וַאֲפִיצֵ֖ם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס

controles.web: Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel. I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel.
controles.kjv: Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel: I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel.
controles.livre: Maldito seu furor, que foi bravio; E sua ira, que foi dura: Eu os dividirei em Jacó, E os espalharei em Israel.

versos.hebraico: יְהוּדָ֗ה אַתָּה֙ יוֹד֣וּךָ אַחֶ֔יךָ יָדְךָ֖ בְּעֹ֣רֶף אֹיְבֶ֑יךָ יִשְׁתַּחֲוּ֥וּ לְךָ֖ בְּנֵ֥י אָבִֽיךָ׃

controles.web: “Judah, your brothers will praise you. Your hand will be on the neck of your enemies. Your father’s sons will bow down before you.
controles.kjv: Judah, thou art he whom thy brethren shall praise: thy hand shall be in the neck of thine enemies; thy father’s children shall bow down before thee.
controles.livre: Judá, teus irmãos te louvarão: Tua mão esterá sobre o pescoço de teus inimigos: Os filhos de teu pai se inclinarão a ti.

versos.hebraico: גּ֤וּר אַרְיֵה֙ יְהוּדָ֔ה מִטֶּ֖רֶף בְּנִ֣י עָלִ֑יתָ כָּרַ֨ע רָבַ֧ץ כְּאַרְיֵ֛ה וּכְלָבִ֖יא מִ֥י יְקִימֶֽנּוּ׃

controles.web: Judah is a lion’s cub. From the prey, my son, you have gone up. He stooped down, he crouched as a lion, as a lioness. Who will rouse him up?
controles.kjv: Judah is a lion’s whelp: from the prey, my son, thou art gone up: he stooped down, he couched as a lion, and as an old lion; who shall rouse him up?
controles.livre: Jovem leão é Judá: Da presa subiste, filho meu: Encurvou-se, lançou-se como leão, Assim como leão velho; quem o despertará?

versos.hebraico: לֹֽא־יָס֥וּר שֵׁ֨בֶט֙ מִֽיהוּדָ֔ה וּמְחֹקֵ֖ק מִבֵּ֣ין רַגְלָ֑יו עַ֚ד כִּֽי־יָבֹ֣א שילה וְל֖וֹ יִקְּהַ֥ת עַמִּֽים׃

controles.web: The scepter will not depart from Judah, nor the ruler’s staff from between his feet, until he comes to whom it belongs. To him will the obedience of the peoples be.
controles.kjv: The sceptre shall not depart from Judah, nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be.
controles.livre: Não será tirado o cetro de Judá, E o legislador dentre seus pés, Até que venha Siló; E a ele se congregarão os povos.

versos.hebraico: אֹסְרִ֤י לַגֶּ֨פֶן֙ עירה וְלַשֹּׂרֵקָ֖ה בְּנִ֣י אֲתֹנ֑וֹ כִּבֵּ֤ס בַּיַּ֨יִן֙ לְבֻשׁ֔וֹ וּבְדַם־עֲנָבִ֖ים סותה׃

controles.web: Binding his foal to the vine, his donkey’s colt to the choice vine; he has washed his garments in wine, his robes in the blood of grapes.
controles.kjv: Binding his foal unto the vine, and his ass’s colt unto the choice vine; he washed his garments in wine, and his clothes in the blood of grapes:
controles.livre: Atando à vide seu jumentinho, E à videira o filho de sua jumenta, Lavou no veio sua roupa, E no sangue de uvas seu manto:

versos.hebraico: חַכְלִילִ֥י עֵינַ֖יִם מִיָּ֑יִן וּלְבֶן־שִׁנַּ֖יִם מֵחָלָֽב׃פ

controles.web: His eyes will be red with wine, his teeth white with milk.
controles.kjv: His eyes shall be red with wine, and his teeth white with milk.
controles.livre: Seus olhos mais vermelhos que o vinho, E os dentes mais brancos que o leite.

versos.hebraico: זְבוּלֻ֕ן לְח֥וֹף יַמִּ֖ים יִשְׁכֹּ֑ן וְהוּא֙ לְח֣וֹף אֳנִיּ֔וֹת וְיַרְכָת֖וֹ עַל־צִידֹֽן׃ס

controles.web: “Zebulun will dwell at the haven of the sea. He will be for a haven of ships. His border will be on Sidon.
controles.kjv: Zebulun shall dwell at the haven of the sea; and he shall be for an haven of ships; and his border shall be unto Zidon.
controles.livre: Zebulom em portos de mar habitará, E será para porto de navios; E seu termo até Sidom.

versos.hebraico: יִשָּׂשכָ֖ר חֲמֹ֣ר גָּ֑רֶם רֹבֵ֖ץ בֵּ֥ין הַֽמִּשְׁפְּתָֽיִם׃

controles.web: “Issachar is a strong donkey, lying down between the saddlebags.
controles.kjv: Issachar is a strong ass couching down between two burdens:
controles.livre: Issacar, asno de forte estrutura deitado entre dois apriscos:

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֤רְא מְנֻחָה֙ כִּ֣י ט֔וֹב וְאֶת־הָאָ֖רֶץ כִּ֣י נָעֵ֑מָה וַיֵּ֤ט שִׁכְמוֹ֙ לִסְבֹּ֔ל וַיְהִ֖י לְמַס־עֹבֵֽד׃ס

controles.web: He saw a resting place, that it was good, the land, that it was pleasant. He bows his shoulder to the burden, and becomes a servant doing forced labor.
controles.kjv: And he saw that rest was good, and the land that it was pleasant; and bowed his shoulder to bear, and became a servant unto tribute.
controles.livre: E viu que o descanso era bom, E que a terra era deleitosa; E baixou seu ombro para levar, E serviu em tributo.

versos.hebraico: דָּ֖ן יָדִ֣ין עַמּ֑וֹ כְּאַחַ֖ד שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: “Dan will judge his people, as one of the tribes of Israel.
controles.kjv: Dan shall judge his people, as one of the tribes of Israel.
controles.livre: Dã julgará a seu povo, Como uma das tribos de Israel.

versos.hebraico: יְהִי־דָן֙ נָחָ֣שׁ עֲלֵי־דֶ֔רֶךְ שְׁפִיפֹ֖ן עֲלֵי־אֹ֑רַח הַנֹּשֵׁךְ֙ עִקְּבֵי־ס֔וּס וַיִּפֹּ֥ל רֹכְב֖וֹ אָחֽוֹר׃

controles.web: Dan will be a serpent on the trail, an adder in the path, That bites the horse’s heels, so that his rider falls backward.
controles.kjv: Dan shall be a serpent by the way, an adder in the path, that biteth the horse heels, so that his rider shall fall backward.
controles.livre: Será Dã serpente junto ao caminho, víbora junto à vereda, que morde os calcanhares dos cavalos, e faz cair por detrás ao cavaleiro deles.

versos.hebraico: לִֽישׁוּעָתְךָ֖ קִוִּ֥יתִי יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: I have waited for your salvation, Yahweh.
controles.kjv: I have waited for thy salvation, O Lord.
controles.livre: Tua salvação espero, ó SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: גָּ֖ד גְּד֣וּד יְגוּדֶ֑נּוּ וְה֖וּא יָגֻ֥ד עָקֵֽב׃ס

controles.web: “A troop will press on Gad, but he will press on their heel.
controles.kjv: Gad, a troop shall overcome him: but he shall overcome at the last.
controles.livre: Gade, exército o atacará; mas ele contra-atacará ao fim.

versos.hebraico: מֵאָשֵׁ֖ר שְׁמֵנָ֣ה לַחְמ֑וֹ וְה֥וּא יִתֵּ֖ן מַֽעֲדַנֵּי־מֶֽלֶךְ׃ס

controles.web: “Asher’s food will be rich. He will yield royal dainties.
controles.kjv: Out of Asher his bread shall be fat, and he shall yield royal dainties.
controles.livre: O pão de Aser será espesso, E ele dará deleites ao rei.

versos.hebraico: נַפְתָּלִ֖י אַיָּלָ֣ה שְׁלֻחָ֑ה הַנֹּתֵ֖ן אִמְרֵי־שָֽׁפֶר׃ס

controles.web: “Naphtali is a doe set free, who bears beautiful fawns.
controles.kjv: Naphtali is a hind let loose: he giveth goodly words.
controles.livre: Naftali, serva solta, que diz belas coisas.

versos.hebraico: בֵּ֤ן פֹּרָת֙ יוֹסֵ֔ף בֵּ֥ן פֹּרָ֖ת עֲלֵי־עָ֑יִן בָּנ֕וֹת צָעֲדָ֖ה עֲלֵי־שֽׁוּר׃

controles.web: “Joseph is a fruitful vine, a fruitful vine by a spring. His branches run over the wall.
controles.kjv: Joseph is a fruitful bough, even a fruitful bough by a well; whose branches run over the wall:
controles.livre: Ramo frutífero é José, ramo frutífero é junto à fonte, cujos ramos se estendem sobre o muro;

versos.hebraico: וַֽיְמָרֲרֻ֖הוּ וָרֹ֑בּוּ וַֽיִּשְׂטְמֻ֖הוּ בַּעֲלֵ֥י חִצִּֽים׃

controles.web: The archers have severely grieved him, shot at him, and persecute him:
controles.kjv: The archers have sorely grieved him, and shot at him, and hated him:
controles.livre: E causaram-lhe amargura, e flecharam-lhe, e os arqueiros o odiaram;

versos.hebraico: וַתֵּ֤שֶׁב בְּאֵיתָן֙ קַשְׁתּ֔וֹ וַיָּפֹ֖זּוּ זְרֹעֵ֣י יָדָ֑יו מִידֵי֙ אֲבִ֣יר יַעֲקֹ֔ב מִשָּׁ֥ם רֹעֶ֖ה אֶ֥בֶן יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: But his bow remained strong. The arms of his hands were made strong, by the hands of the Mighty One of Jacob, (from there is the shepherd, the stone of Israel),
controles.kjv: But his bow abode in strength, and the arms of his hands were made strong by the hands of the mighty God of Jacob; (from thence is the shepherd, the stone of Israel:)
controles.livre: Mas seu arco manteve-se forte, E os braços de suas mãos se fortaleceram pelas mãos do Forte de Jacó, (Dali é o Pastor, e a Pedra de Israel,)

versos.hebraico: מֵאֵ֨ל אָבִ֜יךָ וְיַעְזְרֶ֗ךָּ וְאֵ֤ת שַׁדַּי֙ וִיבָ֣רְכֶ֔ךָּ בִּרְכֹ֤ת שָׁמַ֨יִם֙ מֵעָ֔ל בִּרְכֹ֥ת תְּה֖וֹם רֹבֶ֣צֶת תָּ֑חַת בִּרְכֹ֥ת שָׁדַ֖יִם וָרָֽחַם׃

controles.web: even by the God of your father, who will help you; by the Almighty, who will bless you, with blessings of heaven above, blessings of the deep that lies below, blessings of the breasts, and of the womb.
controles.kjv: Even by the God of thy father, who shall help thee; and by the Almighty, who shall bless thee with blessings of heaven above, blessings of the deep that lieth under, blessings of the breasts, and of the womb:
controles.livre: Do Deus de teu pai, o qual te ajudará, E do Todo-Poderoso, o qual te abençoará com bênçãos dos céus de acima, com bênçãos do abismo que está abaixo, Com bênçãos do seio e da madre.

versos.hebraico: בִּרְכֹ֣ת אָבִ֗יךָ גָּֽבְרוּ֙ עַל־בִּרְכֹ֣ת הוֹרַ֔י עַֽד־תַּאֲוַ֖ת גִּבְעֹ֣ת עוֹלָ֑ם תִּֽהְיֶ֨ין֙ לְרֹ֣אשׁ יוֹסֵ֔ף וּלְקָדְקֹ֖ד נְזִ֥יר אֶחָֽיו׃פ

controles.web: The blessings of your father have prevailed above the blessings of your ancestors, above the boundaries of the ancient hills. They will be on the head of Joseph, on the crown of the head of him who is separated from his brothers.
controles.kjv: The blessings of thy father have prevailed above the blessings of my progenitors unto the utmost bound of the everlasting hills: they shall be on the head of Joseph, and on the crown of the head of him that was separate from his brethren.
controles.livre: As bênçãos de teu pai Foram maiores que as bênçãos de meus progenitores: Até o termo das colinas eternas serão sobre a cabeça de José, E sobre o topo da cabeça do que foi separado de seus irmãos.

versos.hebraico: בִּנְיָמִין֙ זְאֵ֣ב יִטְרָ֔ף בַּבֹּ֖קֶר יֹ֣אכַל עַ֑ד וְלָעֶ֖רֶב יְחַלֵּ֥ק שָׁלָֽל׃

controles.web: “Benjamin is a ravenous wolf. In the morning he will devour the prey. At evening he will divide the plunder.”
controles.kjv: Benjamin shall ravin as a wolf: in the morning he shall devour the prey, and at night he shall divide the spoil.
controles.livre: Benjamim, lobo arrebatador; de manhã comerá a presa, e à tarde repartirá os despojos.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־אֵ֛לֶּה שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל שְׁנֵ֣ים עָשָׂ֑ר וְ֠זֹאת אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּ֨ר לָהֶ֤ם אֲבִיהֶם֙ וַיְבָ֣רֶךְ אוֹתָ֔ם אִ֛ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר כְּבִרְכָת֖וֹ בֵּרַ֥ךְ אֹתָֽם׃

controles.web: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel, and this is what their father spoke to them and blessed them. He blessed everyone according to his blessing.
controles.kjv: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel: and this is it that their father spake unto them, and blessed them; every one according to his blessing he blessed them.
controles.livre: Todos estes foram as doze tribos de Israel: e isto foi o que seu pai lhes disse, e os abençoou; a cada um por sua bênção os abençoou.

versos.hebraico: וַיְצַ֣ו אוֹתָ֗ם וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵהֶם֙ אֲנִי֙ נֶאֱסָ֣ף אֶל־עַמִּ֔י קִבְר֥וּ אֹתִ֖י אֶל־אֲבֹתָ֑י אֶל־הַ֨מְּעָרָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּשְׂדֵ֖ה עֶפְר֥וֹן הַֽחִתִּֽי׃

controles.web: He instructed them, and said to them, “I am to be gathered to my people. Bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,
controles.kjv: And he charged them, and said unto them, I am to be gathered unto my people: bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,
controles.livre: Mandou-lhes logo, e disse-lhes: Eu vou a ser reunido com meu povo: sepultai-me com meus pais na caverna que está no campo de Efrom os heteus;

versos.hebraico: בַּמְּעָרָ֞ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר בִּשְׂדֵ֧ה הַמַּכְפֵּלָ֛ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־פְּנֵי־מַמְרֵ֖א בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן אֲשֶׁר֩ קָנָ֨ה אַבְרָהָ֜ם אֶת־הַשָּׂדֶ֗ה מֵאֵ֛ת עֶפְרֹ֥ן הַחִתִּ֖י לַאֲחֻזַּת־קָֽבֶר׃

controles.web: in the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field from Ephron the Hittite as a burial place.
controles.kjv: In the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field of Ephron the Hittite for a possession of a buryingplace.
controles.livre: Na caverna que está no campo de Macpela, que está diante de Manre na terra de Canaã, a qual comprou Abraão com o mesmo campo de Efrom os heteus, para herança de sepultura.

versos.hebraico: שָׁ֣מָּה קָֽבְר֞וּ אֶת־אַבְרָהָ֗ם וְאֵת֙ שָׂרָ֣ה אִשְׁתּ֔וֹ שָׁ֚מָּה קָבְר֣וּ אֶת־יִצְחָ֔ק וְאֵ֖ת רִבְקָ֣ה אִשְׁתּ֑וֹ וְשָׁ֥מָּה קָבַ֖רְתִּי אֶת־לֵאָֽה׃

controles.web: There they buried Abraham and Sarah, his wife. There they buried Isaac and Rebekah, his wife, and there I buried Leah:
controles.kjv: There they buried Abraham and Sarah his wife; there they buried Isaac and Rebekah his wife; and there I buried Leah.
controles.livre: Ali sepultaram a Abraão e a Sara sua mulher; ali sepultaram a Isaque e a Rebeca sua mulher; ali também sepultei Lia.

versos.hebraico: מִקְנֵ֧ה הַשָּׂדֶ֛ה וְהַמְּעָרָ֥ה אֲשֶׁר־בּ֖וֹ מֵאֵ֥ת בְּנֵי־חֵֽת׃

controles.web: the field and the cave that is therein, which was purchased from the children of Heth.”
controles.kjv: The purchase of the field and of the cave that is therein was from the children of Heth.
controles.livre: O campo e a cova que nele está foram comprados dos filhos de Hete.

versos.hebraico: וַיְכַ֤ל יַעֲקֹב֙ לְצַוֺּ֣ת אֶת־בָּנָ֔יו וַיֶּאֱסֹ֥ף רַגְלָ֖יו אֶל־הַמִּטָּ֑ה וַיִּגְוַ֖ע וַיֵּאָ֥סֶף אֶל־עַמָּֽיו׃

controles.web: When Jacob made an end of charging his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, and yielded up the spirit, and was gathered to his people.
controles.kjv: And when Jacob had made an end of commanding his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, and yielded up the ghost, and was gathered unto his people.
controles.livre: E quando acabou Jacó de dar ordens a seus filhos, encolheu seus pés na cama, e expirou; e foi reunido com seus pais.
